newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Institutions bid keenly for Orogen shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Institutions bid keenly for Orogen shares.

text.p: The first day of institutional bidding for shares in the the Papua New Guinea (PNG) government's Orogen Minerals Ltd indicated that demand was greater than the number of shares available, the lead managers said on Thursday.
Jardine Fleming Ord Minnett and McIntosh Corporate said the bidding by institutions for about 76.8 million shares was spread evenly between Australian and overseas firms.
The bidding for about 50 percent of the shares to be floated by the PNG government opened on Thursday and will close on October 30, with the final price to be issued the next day.

Orogen is due to list on the Australian Stock Exchange on November 1 after raising about A$261 million from an offering to PNG residents, retail investors in Australia and New Zealand, and institutions.

The company will hold the assets of the PNG government's Mineral Resources Development Corp which has stakes in some of the country's largest gold and petroleum projects. The PNG government will have a controlling 51 percent interest.
Retail investors paid A$1.70 per share for their investment, with PNG residents receiving a 10 percent discount for their first 2,000 shares. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
